arithmetic_check: One charge does not close and every other number does. TRIETHYLENEDIAMINE, printed 1g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.008mol). Triethylenediamine is 1,4-diazabicyclo[2.2.2]octane, C6H12N2, MW 112.18. 1 g at 99 percent is 0.99 g, which is 0.008825 mol; the printed figure is 0.008 mol, so the printed mole is 9.4 percent below the mass it is paired with, and 0.008825 does not round to 0.008 at three decimal places, it truncates to it. Inverted, 1 g against 0.008 mol implies MW 125.00 gross or 123.75 net of the 99 percent, against the true 112.18, over-stated by 10.3 percent. For the printed 0.008 mol the charge would need to be 0.897 g net, 0.91 g gross. Neither figure repairs the other and both are recorded as printed. Flag raised: molar_mass_inconsistent. This is not small-number rounding: azobisisobutyronitrile 0.5 g and 0.003 mol closes to 0.5 percent, N,N-dimethylformamide 0.3 g and 0.004 mol to 1.6 percent, acetone cyanohydrin 1 g and 0.011 mol to 1.5 percent, and 1,3-cyclohexanedione in step 3 has MW 112.13, within 0.05 of triethylenediamine's, and its 14.6 g and 0.129 mol pair closes to 0.1 percent. Other charges: substrate C10H10BrClO4S MW 341.60, 35 g at 99.8 percent is 0.10225 mol against 0.102; potassium carbonate MW 138.20, 21.41 g at 99 percent is 0.15337 mol against 0.153; 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol MW 100.04, 15.46 g at 99 percent is 0.15299 mol against 0.153; sodium hydroxide MW 40.00, 4.53 g at 99 percent is 0.11213 mol against 0.112. Product closure: limiting input 0.10225 mol; product C11H10ClF3O5S, MW 346.70; theoretical 35.45 g; printed 31.82 g at the printed 99.8 percent purity is 31.76 g, which is 89.58 percent of theory against the printed 89.6 percent. CLOSES, so mass_balance_implausible is not raised. Scale continuity: 35 g charged against 46 g isolated in step 1, a subset, so scale_discontinuity is not raised.
